static_traits.name: Zhang Jie
static_traits.family_status: 有孩子（来访者认为孩子令人失望）；家中雇有Female佣处理家务
static_traits.medical_history: 此前not yet出现类似心理问题；without既往心理治疗史；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly coherent logic, highly cooperative; able to describe emotions and situations concretely; tone nervous but cooperative attitude positive

basic_info.main_problem: 我正在为“婚姻将以离婚告终”的想法而痛苦，这导致Anxiety和痛苦。
basic_info.core_demands: Seeks counseling to reduce the impact of fear of divorce on mental health, daily functioning and the relationship with the spouse; hopes to improve relationship security through more open communication.

core_beliefs: 亲密关系容易走向失败

special_situations.event: 几个月前与配偶的一次争执（当时感到被误解和not被欣赏）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one serious argument occurs, it means the marriage is heading toward its end
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids difficult conversations and uses work or hobbies to distract attention
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This may be the beginning of the end of our marriage; we will divorce

special_situations.event: 在与配偶互动或讨论重要事项前，即使have not具体问题
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I say one wrong sentence, the relationship will deteriorate and trigger an argument
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Speaks cautiously, shortens communication, tries to avoid sensitive topics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我们会争吵，我会让事情更糟

special_situations.event: 配偶并not yet直接表示not满，但双方关系一度紧张
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果关系氛围紧张，就说明对方not快乐并可能考虑离婚
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces expressing true worries, avoids starting difficult conversations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: TA一定对婚姻not满意，可能在考虑离婚

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and appreciated and to maintain a stable intimate relationship
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、关系破裂与被抛弃
defense_goal: Avoids difficult conversations to maintain superficial peace and reduce conflict
Cautiously restrains oneself to avoid saying the wrong thing and worsening the relationship

object_relations.self_representation: A tense partner walking on 'eggshells', someone who worries about saying the wrong thing
object_relations.object_representation: 可能not满、挑剔且随时会拒绝自己的配偶

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Before having important conversations or intimate interactions with one's spouse, or when needing to express genuine concerns
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets neutral or positive interaction as a signal of potential conflict, believing she will say the wrong thing and cause the relationship to worsen
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 避免直接探讨情感，转而谈工作或其他安全话题；语气谨慎、use模糊表达，尽量缩短交流以降低not适。

manifestations: 因一次争执后持续担忧关系破裂，Anticipation被伴侣拒绝与关系终结
在与配偶互动前反复Anticipation争吵与误解、走在“蛋壳上”
outcomes: Marriage and relationships更为紧张、互动质量下降

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Before interacting with one's spouse, excessive self-scrutiny and caution, choosing words carefully, afraid of saying the wrong thing

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'. Language manifestations include: 'Speaking of which... haha, just kidding', 'In theory...', and so on
manifestations: Uses work or hobbies to distract attention, avoiding opening difficult topics
当感到紧张时Displacement话题而非直接表达担忧

exception_events.target_problem: 在与配偶互动或讨论重要事项前，来访者通常会提前Anticipation争吵与误解、感到强烈Anxiety，并因此回避困难对话。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在一次双方都享受的活动中（一起看电影或散步），来访者感觉更放松，not yet过度Anticipation争吵，互动更自然。
exception_events.reason: not同情境：进行双方都喜爱的活动，氛围轻松；not同做法：专注当下活动而非担忧；关系支持：积极互动降低了紧张感。

positive_force: Positive counseling attitude, willing to try behavioral experiments and open communication
愿意记录并观察互动与情绪变化
Has a certain amount of social support (several friends to confide in)
negative_force: 灾难化、读心术、预测not yet来等认知偏差
回避困难对话与情境，长期Self-monitoring，走在“蛋壳上”
Persistent anxiety导致Disturbed sleep and appetite
将紧张氛围解读为关系失败信号

target_behavior.behavior: 在与配偶互动前和过程中出现Significant anxiety并回避困难对话
antecedent: 准备与配偶互动或讨论重要事项时
回忆起几个月前的那次争执后
target_behavior.core_reason: 一次争执后形成的灾难化认知与负性自动化思维（Mind Reading、Fortune Telling），伴随“我not被理解和not被欣赏”的信念
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在冲突和情绪not适，试图维持表面和平
target_behavior.consequence: Marriage and relationships更紧张、误解累积、Anxiety持续；睡眠与食欲受到干扰；Decline in work performance
